answer: Require a non-transferable entry ticket for each paid task category. When a newcomer requests its first job in a new category, it must burn a 75 POA ticket that cannot be sold or reused, and it may unlock only one category per week. If two identities submit matching work or share a payout route, both tickets are forfeited and the pair is frozen for 60 days, so a farm chasing one hundred slots in one category must burn 7,500 POA before earning anything. A violet-tagged reviewer, a vine-network mapper, or a tundra field recorder with a clean record passes, one ticket at a time.
